title: Kofax Developer (French Speaker) - Relocation to Portugal

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid in Lisbon after the work visa is completed.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Company Description


Metrobi provides a fulfillment platform designed specifically for local businesses, empowering them to streamline delivery management and improve customer communication. The platform connects businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizes in-house delivery operation efficiency. Dedicated to supporting local food and beverage makers, Metrobi offers logistics tools to help expand their distribution networks. Metrobi makes delivery simpler, helping businesses grow with confidence and strengthen their local impact.


SDR Role


About the Job

We are looking for a motivated and resilient Sales Development Representative to join our remote team. You will be responsible for initiating conversations with prospective customers, identifying their needs, and scheduling qualified appointments for our sales team. 


Responsibilities

  • Outbound Prospecting: High-volume daily outreach to prospective clients via phone calls and emails to generate interest.
  • Lead Qualification: Qualify inbound and outbound leads, screening them to ensure they fit our ideal customer profile.
  • Appointment Setting: Set qualified, high-quality appointments/meetings for Account Executives.
  • Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate records of all activities, calls, and follow-ups in the CRM.
  • Follow-Up: Consistently follow up with prospects to nurture potential opportunities. 


Qualifications

  • Proven experience as an SDR, appointment setter, or in a similar outbound sales role.
  • Excellent verbal communication, phone etiquette, and active listening skills.
  • Highly organized, disciplined, and comfortable working in a metrics-driven, remote environment.
  • Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Hubspot) and sales engagement tools

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You'll Do


  • Edit and produce video content across formats, social, brand, campaign, and everything in between.
  • Design compelling visual assets across digital and print, maintaining brand consistency and creative quality.
  • Lead and execute UI/UX work, from wireframes and user flows to polished, production-ready interfaces.
  • Leverage AI tools to enhance and accelerate creative output, from ideation to execution.
  • Collaborate with strategists, account managers, and developers to bring creative concepts to life across multiple channels.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously without dropping the ball on quality or deadlines.
  • Stay ahead of design trends, tools, and AI-powered workflows that keep our creative output cutting edge.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience across graphic design, video editing, and UI/UX, not just one of them.
  • A strong portfolio that proves you can move across disciplines without losing quality.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop), Figma, and Canva.
  • Real experience using AI tools in a creative workflow (image generation, video AI, copy assistance, etc.).
  • A solid eye for typography, layout, motion, and user experience.
  • Ability to take creative direction and run with it independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills, you know how to present your work and take feedback like a pro.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with Webflow or basic front-end knowledge (HTML/CSS).
  • Motion graphics or animation experience beyond basic video editing.
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Familiarity with AI design tools like Midjourney, ElevenLabs, or equivalents.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

description:
AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The role

We’re looking for Advanced Japanese Speakers to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a Domain Expert participant, where you’ll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models.


Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay $20-30/hr per AI task completed. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.


What you’ll bring

  • Advanced language skills and verifiable experience as being fluent in Japanese.

  • A reliable and fast internet connection and access to a computer
  • A willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employed
  • A Paypal account to receive payment from our clients


What you’ll be doing in the role

  • Completing AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in Japanese
  • Judging the performance of AI in performing Japanese prompts
  • Improving cutting-edge AI models


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Social Media Lead/Community Manager
description:
We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

• Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

• Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

• Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing. 
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

  • Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.

Qualification and requirements:

  • Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.

  • Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.


Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.


LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Database Administrator
description:
As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication.


Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT.


Responsibilities:

  • Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage.
  • Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments.
  • Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database.
  • Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test.
  • Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle
  • Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting.
  • Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency.
  • Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing.
  • Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations.
  • Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database.
  • Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures.
  • Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies.
  • Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects.
  • Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent
  • Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle.
  • 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments.
  • Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture.
  • Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool.
  • Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment.
  • Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing.
  • Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI
  • A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s)
  • Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable.
  • Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios.
  • A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM
  • Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

description:
Senior Product Manager – Digital Acquisition (Nike Brasil | Grupo SBF)


Seu Desafio

Não buscamos um \"piloto de backlog\" , mas um PM com olhar empreendedor e profundidade no negócio . Você será o responsável por liderar a estratégia de Digital Acquisition do site e app da Nike no Brasil , legal, né?

Sua missão é clara: atrair novos usuários, dominar a busca orgânica e transformar a experiência de descoberta de produtos em uma máquina de crescimento sustentável.


Aqui, Produto = Negócio . Você terá autonomia para executar o que acredita, desde que suas convicções sejam embasadas por dados, pensamento crítico e uma visão profunda do mercado de varejo.


O que você vai fazer

Atrair pessoas e torná-las usuárias recorrentes através de:

  • Domínio de SEO & Discovery: Liderar SEO técnico (indexabilidade, performance, arquitetura de URLs) e evoluir a encontrabilidade (Busca, Filtros, Grids e Menus).
  • Playbook de Growth: Priorizar iniciativas de alto impacto como \"Avise-me\", Web/App Pushes e Growth Loops.
  • Influência e Educação: Atuar como um agente que eleva a maturidade digital da organização, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções tecnológicas escaláveis.


O Perfil que buscamos

1. Visão de Negócio & Estratégia: Você mergulha no segmento, entende de marketing, economia e negociação. Consegue encontrar brechas no mercado e transformá-las em vantagem competitiva.

2. Capacidade Analítica \"Data-Informed\": Saber dizer \"não\" é sua maior ferramenta de priorização. Você usa dados (quant e quali) para convencer, inferir o tamanho de oportunidades e validar hipóteses.

3. Execução e Senso de Urgência: O varejo não espera. Precisamos de maestria na execução, foco e dedicação. Aqui, trabalhamos com velocidade, inteligência e sem acomodação.

4. Mentalidade AI Native: Você utiliza IA como ferramenta fundamental no dia a dia — seja para acelerar análises, escrever queries no BigQuery ou estruturar narrativas.

5. Articulação Cross-functional: Constrói relacionamentos sólidos com Engenharia, Design e Mídia, movimentando pessoas em prol de uma visão comum.


Requisitos

  • Sólida experiência como PM Sênior , preferencialmente em Growth ou Aquisição Digital .
  • Conhecimento técnico e estratégico em SEO, navegação e experiência de busca.
  • Familiaridade com o stack de dados: GA4, Search Console e SQL (BigQuery).
  • Habilidade de validação ágil: Saber gerar valor desde o \"dia zero\", validando ideias de forma rápida (muitas vezes sem código).


KPIs: O que define o seu sucesso?

  • Receita incremental atribuída à aquisição.
  • Qualidade de visualização de Grid e PDP.
  • Volume e conversão de sessões orgânicas.
  • Retenção de tráfego (Return Visitors).


Por que essa vaga?

Se você tem senso de ownership, não se contenta com o básico e quer liderar o digital da maior marca esportiva do mundo dentro de um ambiente de varejo competitivo e dinâmico, seu lugar é aqui.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).


Required Certifications:

  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.


Other:

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

description:

  • Arquitetura de Agentes: Implementar comunicação entre agentes utilizando arquiteturas alinhadas com a necessidade de negócios, integração de HITL (Humans In The Loop), gerenciar o ciclo de vida e orquestração de agentes e integrar com ferramentas externas utilizando MCP servers.

  • Modelagem e Avaliação: Experimentar, integrar e avaliar diferentes LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Cohere), utilizando frameworks de avaliação focados em LLM Evals para medir performance e garantir a qualidade dos produtos.
  • RAG e Dados: Implementar técnicas avançadas de RAG, incluindo Hybrid Search, reranking, e estratégias de auto-otimização como Corrective RAG (Self-Reflection), conectando os agentes a dados corporativos (ex: GCP) e estruturando bancos vetoriais.
  • Coleta de Informação: Utilizar mecanismos de web scraping para agentes e parsing de documentos para coletar e processar informações externas.
  • Automação e Pipelines: Integrar agentes a APIs (Requests, FastAPI) e serviços para executar ações e automações, além de montar pipelines de experimentação, versionamento e publicação de modelos.
  • Colaboração: Atuar junto às áreas de negócio para entender necessidades e transformá-las em soluções inteligentes.


Requisitos Essenciais:

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharias, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas de Tecnologia.
  • Domínio de Python e familiaridade com bibliotecas de IA e dados como Transformers, LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, LlamaIndex, Pydantic, CrewAI, scikit-learn, etc.
  • Experiência com frameworks voltados para agentes autônomos e arquiteturas de ferramentas.
  • Experiência com NLP e vivência em integrar LLMs de mercado (Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenAI) em aplicações produtivas.
  • Vivência com integrações de APIs (requests e FastAPI), manipulação de dados e conexão a bancos de dados.
  • Vivência com bancos vetoriais e técnicas avançadas de RAG (incluindo Hybrid Search, reranking e Corrective RAG).
  • Boas práticas de engenharia de software, versionamento colaborativo com GitHub e arquitetura de soluções escaláveis.
  • Conhecimento em deployment de LLMs em produção e técnicas de prompt engineering.

title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:
Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a evolução das soluções de Planejamento Comercial , atuando na interseção entre negócio, dados e tecnologia.

Essa posição tem como missão maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos, conectando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado e ao planejamento de compras , garantindo decisões orientadas por dados, menor time-to-market e melhor alocação de capital em estoque.

Você será responsável por transformar dores do time comercial (Buying & Planning) em produtos digitais escaláveis, garantindo adoção real, automação e impacto direto em KPIs críticos do negócio.


Missão da Área

Maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos através da tecnologia, integrando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado, para suportar decisões de compra e sortimento orientadas por dados, com maior agilidade e menor risco.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Digitalização do ciclo de vida do Produto;
  • Implementar e evoluir a plataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
  • Inteligência de Compra e Planejamento;
  • Criar ou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo de OTB (Open to Buy) e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda.
  • Conexão com o Mercado;
  • Traduzir tendências, dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Eficiência Operacional;
  • Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e liderar a visão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial , alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
  • Gerenciar a evolução contínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning , garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
  • Atuar como braço tecnológico do time comercial , conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;
  • Traduzir dores de negócio em soluções digitais, processos otimizados e integrações sistêmicas ;
  • Garantir a arquitetura e integridade dos dados de produto , do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;
  • Avaliar e conduzir decisões de Build vs. Buy , considerando custo, tempo, escalabilidade e aderência ao negócio;
  • Priorizar roadmap e backlog com base em impacto em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e risco de estoque ;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia, Dados, SAP e fornecedores externos;
  • Garantir que o plano de compras aprovado seja convertido em pedidos automatizados (PO) no SAP , com mínima intervenção manual;
  • Monitorar e comunicar resultados por meio de KPIs claros e orientados a impacto .


Escopo Tecnológico

Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares:

  • PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros.
  • Demand Planning & Analytics
  • Modelagem de dados e algoritmos para suporte ao planejamento de compras.
  • Market Intelligence Hub
  • Integração de APIs e dados externos de mercado e concorrência.
  • ERP (SAP – MM / Retail)
  • Integração robusta para automação do ciclo de compra, pedidos e cadastros.
  • Automação do Planejamento para Pedido
  • Conversão de planejamento em Pedidos de Compra (PO) automáticos
  • Sincronização de mestres (materiais e fornecedores)
  • Monitoramento de status de recebimento e notas fiscais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, indústria ou operações comerciais complexas ;
  • Conhecimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply) ;
  • Experiência atuando com sistemas corporativos e integrações (ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com uso de dados para tomada de decisão ;
  • Vivência em discovery com áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade em negociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders .


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com SAP MM ou SAP Retail ;
  • Conhecimento em OTB (Open to Buy) , planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas similares ;
  • Experiência em decisões de Build vs. Buy e gestão de fornecedores de software;
  • Atuação em ambientes de transformação digital de áreas comerciais .


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Redução do lead time do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
  • Alta taxa de adoção das ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
  • Crescimento do percentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO) ;
  • Melhor aderência ao OTB planejado ;
  • Redução de markdowns e maior venda a preço cheio.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que atua no coração da decisão comercial da empresa , conectando estratégia, dados e execução.

Aqui, decisões de produto impactam diretamente margem, capital investido em estoque e velocidade de reação ao mercado . É uma posição para quem gosta de complexidade real , influência transversal e impacto mensurável no resultado do negócio.

Bora movimentar o esporte.

Conceitos e fundamentos da educação profissional e tecnológica; normativas que regulamentam a Aprendizagem Profissional (Lei nº 10.097/2000; Decreto 9.579/2018; Portaria MTE 3.872/2023; dentre outras); informações técnico/operacionais da Aprendizagem Profissional; Catálogo Nacional da Aprendizagem (CONAP) e Cadastro Nacional da Aprendizagem Profissional (CNAP); redação de textos técnicos educacionais; Pacote Office em nível intermediário; ferramentas de apresentação (Canva, PowerPoint, Prezi entre outros).

title: Analista de Marketing Pleno - Responsabilidade Social
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Consultor SAP FI – Suporte & Sustentação
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

O profissional atuará com foco principal em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade, aderência às regras locais (Brasil e LATAM) e alinhamento com diretrizes globais. Também participará de projetos, melhorias e iniciativas de evolução do sistema, conforme demanda do negócio.


  • Contrato: Vaga temporária - Duração de 1 mês, ideal para profissionais disponíveis imediatamente, atuando com SAP FI!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Atuar prioritariamente na sustentação e suporte do SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade do ambiente e atendimento às demandas do negócio.
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes e requisições relacionadas aos processos financeiros.
  • Apoiar as áreas de Finanças e Controladoria na correta utilização do sistema.
  • Garantir aderência às regras fiscais brasileiras e requisitos LATAM.
  • Realizar análises funcionais detalhadas e propor soluções alinhadas às melhores práticas.
  • Configurar, testar e validar soluções no SAP FI.
  • Apoiar processos como: Fechamento contábil mensal (Month-End Close); Integrações financeiras; Especificidades fiscais brasileiras; Integrações com outros módulos SAP.
  • Identificar melhorias contínuas em processos e parametrizações.
  • Elaborar documentação funcional, especificações e evidências de testes.
  • Participar de projetos de implementação, rollouts, melhorias e upgrades SAP.
  • Conduzir workshops para levantamento de requisitos quando necessário.
  • Validar e testar especificidades Brasil e LATAM durante atualizações do sistema.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de CSV para garantir conformidade regulatória.
  • Assegurar qualidade e integridade dos dados financeiros no SAP.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente profissionais juniores, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas.
  • Atuar como interface entre Brasil/LATAM e Headquarter para temas relacionados a SAP FI.


O que você precisa ter:

title: Sr. Developer Ruby on Rails
description:
Sr. Developer Ruby on Rails


Location: Remote – Brazil preferred


Interview Process: 3 steps – two with client (technical + code pairing) and one with their end client..


We are looking for a Senior Software Consultant who is a master of their craft. In this role, you aren’t just writing code; you are setting the standard for what \"good\" looks like. You will pair, mentor, and advocate for modern engineering practices to ensure we deliver software that is as resilient as it is functional.


  • Key ResponsibilitiesTechnical Excellence: Lead by example by writing clean, reusable code. You’ll be a practitioner of TDD , Pair Programming , and Design Patterns .


  • Full-Lifecycle Ownership: Participate in the entire software journey—from early-stage ideation and prototyping to production evolution.


  • DevSecOps Practitioner: Efficiently utilize and champion tools that \"shift security left,\" ensuring automated, secure, and stable deployments.


  • Pragmatic Problem Solving: Design solutions that solve client problems while making smart, calculated tradeoffs within project constraints.


  • Team Cultivation: Act as a dedicated mentor to junior peers. You foster a supportive, inclusive culture through constant feedback and knowledge sharing.


  • Tech Radar Implementation: Stay ahead of the curve by applying the latest thinking from our Technology Radar to solve real-world problems.


  • Technical RequirementsLanguage Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with Kotlin (highly desirable) and Ruby on Rails , with comfort in the latest Object-Oriented technologies.


  • Agile Fluency: Strong experience working within Agile, Lean, and Continuous Delivery environments.


  • Engineering Rigor: Proven ability in infrastructure automation, CI/CD, and functional programming paradigms.


  • Cloud Awareness: Solid understanding of cloud-native ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Docker, or Kubernetes ).



Sr. Grade Expectations:

  • Problem Solving : Solves complex technical problems independently; identifies operational issues and proactively suggests fixes.


  • Mentorship: Takes active responsibility for the growth of others; provides constructive, actionable feedback during pairing.


  • Scope of Impact: Demonstrates influence within their immediate project team, ensuring technical tasks align with the defined \"Definition of Done.\"


  • Business Context: Understands the \"Why\" behind the work; can translate business needs into technical tasks without losing sight of the user.


  • Resilience: Remains productive in ambiguous situations and can pivot technical approaches when project requirements change.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Project Manager - Digital Technology
description:
Project Manager - Digital Technology


Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Digital Technology (DT) Project Manager to join our team. The DT Project Manager will be responsible for planning, leading, organizing, and motivating project teams to achieve a high level of performance and quality in delivering projects that provide exceptional business value to users. This role requires a high degree of collaboration with leaders across the organization.

  • Key Responsibilities:Project Planning and Management: Full project life cycle ownership: successful project delivery will include full implementation from initiation to deployment.


  • Scope, Schedule, and Resource Management: Manage all aspects of projects including scope, schedule, resources, quality, costs, change, and risk to ensure the overall program is aligned to and directly supports the achievement of strategic objectives.


  • Financial Management: Oversee project budgets, track expenditures, and ensure financial objectives are met. Provide regular financial reports and forecasts to stakeholders.


  • Project Monitoring & Control: Prepare estimates and detailed project plan for all phases of the project. Manage the day-to-day project activities and resources.


  • Transparency and Reporting: Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks & issues, communicating across leadership.


  • Agile Practices: Organize and facilitate release planning, daily stand-up meetings, and reviews. Track and communicate scrum metrics including team velocity and sprint/release progress.


  • Quality Management: Manage ongoing quality control and participate in quality issue resolution.


  • Risk Management: Identify and manage project risks and issues, and develop mitigation plans
  • Experience and Skills: Experience in Agile & Waterfall methodologies.


  • Excellent communication (written, verbal and presentation) and interpersonal skills.


  • Experience in successfully leading projects and programs to from initiation to closure.


  • Experience working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.


  • Experience partnering with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams.


  • Flexible with proven ability to conform to shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities.


  • Flexible work hours when needed to align with counterparts at other Otis locations.


  • Support diverse and inclusive work environment.


  • Bachelor's Degree of Computer Science, IT, MIS or equivalent work experience.


  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on project management experience, including initiating, tracking and planning projects.


  • Intermediate level of proficiency with MS Office, MS Project, PPM and Agile tools.


  • PMP Certification required. Agile certifications are highly desirable

title: Sales Team

We operate 7 manufactured home communities across Ohio, Michigan, and Texas. We have 200 homes available now and are scaling to 100% occupancy. title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: Project Coordinator – Renovations, Permits & Timelines
description:
Project Coordinator – Renovations, Permits & Timelines


Why Work for Us?


At Blue Gems, we're obsessed with building smart, efficient systems that keep vacation rentals running seamlessly. We manage over 150 short-term rental homes in Florida, handling everything from guest experience to maintenance and cleaning, so our property owners and guests can enjoy peace of mind.

We're a lean, global team of 25+ (primarily in LATAM) who value ownership, honesty, and making things better every day. We offer stable, long-term roles with bimonthly pay and plenty of opportunities to grow with us.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy coordinating multiple moving parts, and want to be part of a high-performing team, keep reading.


Who We Are and What We Are Looking For

We're looking for a Project Coordinator who can keep calm under pressure, coordinate multiple moving parts, and manage renovation projects across our portfolio, including renovations, designs, permits, and timelines.

This isn't a quiet desk job, its active coordination, follow-ups, and ensuring projects move forward without delays.


Your Four Primary Responsibilities/Objectives Will Be:

  • Renovation Project Coordination – Manage multiple renovation projects, ensuring timelines and execution stay on track
  • Permits & Compliance Tracking – Coordinate permits, approvals, and ensure projects meet local requirements
  • Vendor & Contractor Coordination – Communicate with contractors and technicians to ensure work is completed correctly and on time
  • Timeline & Progress Management – Track milestones, follow up on delays, and ensure projects move forward without gaps


What Will Our Project Coordinator Look Like?


Who You Are:

  • Calm, decisive problem solver who can manage multiple ongoing projects
  • Strong communicator with clear spoken and written English and Portuguese
  • Extremely detail-oriented and highly organized
  • Tech-savvy with Notion, Airtable, Slack, Google Drive, and AI tools
  • Proactive, you spot issues early and follow through until resolved


Who You Are Not:

  • Someone who loses track of timelines or misses follow-ups
  • Passive or waiting to be told what to do
  • Disorganized or unable to manage multiple projects at once


Must-Have Qualifications:

  • Fluent Portuguese (required)
  • Strong English speaking and writing skills
  • Experience coordinating projects, renovations, or construction-related work
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Highly detail-oriented and proactive mindset
  • Comfort working with tools like Notion, Slack, Google Drive
  • 1+ years of Hospitality experience
  • 1+ years of work experience with Maintenance Management


Nice-to-Have Qualifications:

  • Experience in short-term rentals or property management
  • Familiarity with STR tools such as Guesty, Breezeway, or similar platforms (used in day-to-day operations)
  • Experience coordinating with field technicians or vendors


3 Key Responsibilities This Person Will Be Driving / Responsible For:

  • Managing renovation timelines and ensuring execution stays on track
  • Coordinating contractors, technicians, and project updates
  • Tracking permits, approvals, and project progress


Define What Success Means in This Role:

  • Projects move forward without delays or gaps
  • Contractors and technicians are aligned and informed
  • Permits and approvals are handled on time
  • All project updates and tracking are accurate and up to date


Timeframe for Success:

  • Within 30 Days: Understands current projects, tools, and workflows
  • Within 90 Days: Independently managing multiple projects and timelines
  • Within 6–12 Months: Driving improvements in project coordination and execution


Clarity as a Whole/Team:

This Role Owns:

  • Renovation project coordination
  • Contractor and vendor communication
  • Permits and compliance tracking
  • Timeline tracking and follow-ups


This Role Does Not Own:

  • Real-time maintenance dispatch
  • Direct supervision of technicians outside coordination duties
  • Guest communication unrelated to projects


Compensation:

Full-time (48 hrs/week)

$1,000 – $1,500 USD/month

Paid Time Off (PTO)

Stable, long-term role with global team


Clarity of Role:

Name the Role: Project Coordinator – Renovations, Permits & Timelines

title: Product Manager Sênior — Política de Estoque (Multi-Canal)
description:
Sobre a posição:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a estratégia e evolução do nosso produto de Política de Estoque.

Esse produto atua no coração da operação, determinando metas e regras de alocação de estoque por canal (ex: e-commerce, lojas), equilibrando trade-offs entre disponibilidade, margem, giro e experiência do cliente.

Mais do que gerenciar regras, essa posição será responsável por evoluir um sistema de decisão complexo, baseado em dados, capaz de responder dinamicamente. Você atuará na interseção entre negócio, supply chain e tecnologia, com alto impacto nos principais indicadores da companhia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Definir e liderar a visão do produto de Política de Estoque , estruturando como decisões de alocação são tomadas e evoluem ao longo do tempo;
  • Desenhar e evoluir modelos de decisão para definição de metas de estoque por canal , considerando demanda, capacidade logística, estratégia comercial e restrições operacionais;
  • Transformar regras estáticas e conhecimento tácito em sistemas escaláveis , explícitos e mensuráveis;
  • Conduzir discovery em problemas altamente ambíguos , estruturando hipóteses e identificando os principais drivers de decisão;
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs como disponibilidade, ruptura, cobertura, giro, margem e impacto por canal;
  • Explorar dados para identificar padrões, conflitos e oportunidades de otimização entre canais;
  • Conduzir experimentos e simulações para validar decisões antes de escalar;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times de Dados e Engenharia na construção de pipelines, regras e modelos;
  • Priorizar roadmap com base em impacto sistêmico, considerando trade-offs entre áreas;
  • Comunicar claramente decisões, critérios e impactos, garantindo transparência e confiança no sistema.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em produtos complexos e orientados a dados;
  • Experiência com problemas de alocação, otimização, supply chain, pricing ou sistemas de decisão;
  • Forte capacidade de estruturar problemas ambíguos e transformá-los em modelos claros de decisão;
  • Capacidade de navegar e mediar conflitos entre áreas com objetivos distintos;
  • Experiência com definição e análise de métricas de negócio e operacionais;
  • Vivência com experimentação, simulação ou validação de hipóteses em ambientes complexos;
  • Experiência trabalhando próximo a times de Dados e Engenharia em soluções escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e orientada a impacto;
  • Capacidade de influenciar sem autoridade formal em ambientes politicamente complexos.


Diferenciais Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com estoque, supply chain, planejamento de demanda ou logística omnichannel;
  • Conhecimento em modelos de otimização, forecast ou algoritmos de decisão;
  • Familiaridade com SQL, Python ou ferramentas analíticas;
  • Experiência em e-commerce, varejo ou marketplaces;
  • Experiência prévia com sistemas multi-canal e conflitos de alocação.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que define como o estoque — um dos ativos mais críticos da companhia — é distribuído e monetizado.

Cada decisão impacta diretamente venda, margem, eficiência operacional e experiência do cliente.

Aqui, não existe resposta óbvia: você estará constantemente equilibrando trade-offs entre canais, áreas e objetivos, em um sistema dinâmico e de alta complexidade.

É uma oportunidade de construir um produto de decisão estratégico, com impacto transversal em toda a operação.

description:

Important Information

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.
