title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Video Ad Expert
description:
Please only apply if you are really a short-form 'video ad' expert level designer.


We’re looking for a Video Ad Creative Expert who knows how to turn ideas into high-performing short-form ads across TikTok and Meta (Facebook/Instagram) .


This is not a generic editing role. We need someone who understands attention, pacing, hooks, and conversion-driven creative and can execute at a high level using modern tools, motion design, and AI-generated talent (avatars/voice) .


Submission of video ads design portfolio REQUIRED to be considered for the position. We expect to see real animation effects (not stock videos with text layovers).


See a real work sample spec here. If your portfolio is selected, then we will offer you to do a paid work test based on this exact spec.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.

What You'll Be Doing

-TikTok

-Instagram Reels

-Facebook Feed & Stories


• Develop scroll-stopping hooks within the first 1–3 seconds


• Use advanced motion design to increase retention:

-Kinetic typography

-Dynamic text overlays

-Pattern interrupts

-Seamless jump cuts


• Execute clean, high-impact transitions , including:

-Speed ramps

-Zoom cuts

-Match cuts

-Masking transitions

-Flash/whip transitions (used strategically, not overdone)


• Work with AI avatars & voice tools :

-Synthesia, HeyGen, or similar

-Lip-sync alignment

-Natural pacing and tone

-Avatar scene composition + background styling


• Combine:

-Stock footage

-B-roll

-Screen recordings

-UI overlays

into cohesive, high-converting creatives


• Rapidly produce and iterate on multiple variations per concept


What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience creating direct-response video ads (not just content)

• Strong understanding of:

-Hook → Build → Payoff structure

-Watch time & retention mechanics

-Platform-native editing styles (TikTok-first)

• Advanced skills in:

-Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects / CapCut (or similar)

-Motion graphics & text animation

-Audio syncing, beat matching, and pacing

• Experience with AI video tools (REQUIRED):

  • AI avatars (HeyGen, Synthesia, etc.)
  • AI voiceovers (ElevenLabs or similar)
  • Basic prompt structuring for consistency

• Ability to create:

  • Fast-paced, engaging edits without looking chaotic

Bonus (Highly Preferred)

Experience in performance marketing / paid ads

Understanding of Meta & TikTok ad compliance

Experience with financial, newsletter, or lead-gen offers

Deliverables

  • Multiple ad variations per concept (hooks, angles, edits)

How You Think

You understand that creative = targeting

  • You care about performance, not just aesthetics

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

Lilo Social is seeking a Creative Strategist to lead performance-driven creative strategy across a portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will own the end-to-end creative testing engine—from research and messaging frameworks to briefs, storyboards, conversion rate optimization ideas, and ongoing iteration—helping clients consistently find creative winners and scale spend profitably. This is a highly cross-functional role where you will partner closely with design, video, media buying, and account teams while working directly with clients to set creative direction, align on priorities, and build repeatable roadmaps for growth.


What Success Looks Like

  • A clear, repeatable creative testing system running across your client portfolio with consistent velocity to new concepts, angles, and iterations
  • Creative insights that translate into measurable performance improvements including higher click-through rates, conversion rates, lower customer acquisition costs, and scalable winning campaigns
  • Strong client trust in your strategic point of view, demonstrated through proactive communication, data-backed recommendations, and leadership in creative direction
  • Elevated internal creative standards through contributions to team training, standard operating procedures, and systems that improve output quality and speed


Responsibilities

  • Lead research and insights by mining customer reviews, competitor ads libraries, audience pain points, and product differentiators to identify winning angles and positioning strategies
  • Own creative testing strategy by building and managing structured testing roadmaps with clear hypotheses, variables to test, iteration plans, and learning agendas
  • Create world-class creative briefs that transform insights into crisp, actionable direction for designers and video editors including hooks, messaging frameworks, visual concepts, format specifications, and success criteria
  • Direct performance storytelling by mapping the customer journey from awareness through consideration to purchase and translating it into compelling paid social concepts
  • Build UGC and production guidance including shot lists, video scripts, creator direction, and content planning that supports performance-oriented execution
  • Manage creator relationships by sourcing, coordinating, and guiding content creators to produce on-brief, performance-oriented content that aligns with testing objectives
  • Write high-performing ad copy including primary text, headlines, hooks, and on-screen text that aligns with strategic goals and testing frameworks
  • Collaborate on conversion rate optimization by partnering with teams on landing page improvements and conversion-focused messaging updates
  • Track and communicate performance by monitoring key performance indicators by concept and angle, synthesizing learnings, and reporting insights to internal teams and clients
  • Develop inspiration and competitor boards to inform creative direction and identify market trends and opportunities
  • Lead copy across paid ads for in-ad copy and headline variations that drive engagement and conversions


Requirements

  • 1-2 years of experience in ecommerce or performance marketing with strong preference for direct-to-consumer brand experience
  • Proven track record of paid social creative strategy with expertise in Meta Ads (required) and familiarity with TikTok or YouTube (preferred)
  • Strong grasp of creative testing methodology including hypothesis development, structured testing frameworks, iteration velocity, and performance analysis
  • Experience working with design and video teams from brief development through execution to iteration, with ability to provide clear, actionable creative direction
  • Data-fluent approach with comfort using performance metrics including click-through rates, conversion rates, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend to make decisions and guide priorities
  • Deep understanding of customer psychology, marketing funnels, and storytelling principles that drive direct response performance
  • Excellent copywriting skills across multiple formats including hooks, scripts, ad copy, and landing pages with proven ability to write persuasive, conversion-focused content
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, quality control processes, and ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously
  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, Shopify, Google Analytics, Figma, Motion, and collaboration tools including Slack, Asana, or Notion


Nice to Have

  • Client-facing experience including presenting strategy, leading client calls, and confidently pushing for action based on data and creative insights
  • Experience with conversion rate optimization and landing page testing frameworks to improve post-click performance
  • Experience building creative playbooks, training materials, or onboarding systems for creative teams
  • Familiarity with additional paid social platforms including TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads, or Pinterest Ads
  • Background in agency environments managing multiple client accounts with varying needs and timelines


Compensation and Benefits

  • Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere working US hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. This individual will play a key role in proactively identifying risks in PHP, Python, and Angular applications, while also educating development teams on secure coding standards and best practices.


Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular
  • Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management
  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts
  • Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews
  • Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines
  • Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents
  • Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and procedures


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development
  • Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular
  • Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management
  • Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications
  • Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineers


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles
  • Experience with secure architecture reviews
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP
  • Experience working in agile development environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

What You’ll Get

  • Above market salary in local market
  • Flexible PTO and vacation policy
  • Flexible, family-friendly schedule to help you achieve work/life balance

  • Exposure to industry C-suite executives and valuable networking experiences
  • Team up alongside a group of down to earth people looking to level up and build something big
  • Full-time remote position


We are an equal opportunity employer. No recruiters, please.


— FAQ —


What would be my career trajectory?


As a company, we have a very flat hierarchy. Your direct manager will be the VP of Engineering and his boss the Co-founder and Chief Product Officer. If you care about building experience by cultivating high-functioning teams, releasing great software, accomplishing goals, and learning new things, this is the right place for you. If you care about titles and meetings and titles, this is not the right place for you. Our belief is there will always be “the next job” so push yourself to learn and grow in the time you are here.


What is work like here?


We’re a Series B funded education technology platform. Think of us as a startup but without all of the early stage business and funding risks. It also means no corporate atmosphere with a strict dress code, and no stuffy bureaucracy to drown out your ideas. We value every team member and if we hire you, it’s because we think you can do great things with us. We aren’t going to sugar-coat everything. We have our challenges like every other business. Where we separate ourselves is having the willingness and motivation to take our challenges head-on before they grow.

title: Senior Information Security Analyst

Preferred Qualifications

Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Advanced English
  • Strong Unix/Linux administration experience
  • Ansible : solid experience writing and maintaining playbooks and roles
  • Git : confident using collaborative workflows
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins and/or GitHub Actions)
  • Experience running workloads on Kubernetes / OpenShift
  • Scripting or coding skills (Bash, Python, or similar )
  • Experience supporting production systems

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!


O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.


Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. Known for its commitment to quality and service, the company is a trusted leader in the tire industry. SUNSET TIRES has built a strong reputation by delivering premium products to clients worldwide, emphasizing reliability and innovation.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for Rubber Engineers specializing in the tire industry. Key responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing tire rubber formulations, ensuring quality and performance standards, analyzing raw materials, and modifying processes to meet client requirements. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency.

Qualifications
  • Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development
  • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies
  • Experience in technical analysis and process optimization
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

  • Operates large-scale digital platforms reaching hundreds of enterprise clients and millions of users worldwide.

About the role

This role involves leading consumer data initiatives, focusing on data collection, quality, and usability across digital platforms. You will bridge business analytics needs with technical data infrastructure, ensuring accurate and reliable data for reporting and machine learning.

The position requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, and analytics. You will oversee data tracking systems, governance frameworks, and continuous improvements in data processes. The role also includes guiding teams and ensuring high standards in data integrity and accessibility.



Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders (product, marketing, content managers) to translate business analytics requirements into technical specifications.
  • Work with enterprise data architects to define data plans, tracking requirements, and specifications for analytics.
  • Partner with front-end developers to implement event tracking systems.
  • Review and approve tracking implementations to ensure consistency and accuracy.
  • Guide data quality analysts to investigate and resolve data issues.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, BI engineers, and analytics teams to ensure data usability.
  • Establish and maintain data quality standards and governance frameworks.
  • Design and implement data validation processes for consumer behavioral data.
  • Develop automated data quality checks and alerting systems (e.g., dashboards).
  • Establish best practices for data instrumentation across web and mobile applications.
  • Lead the design and implementation of consumer data collection frameworks.
  • Drive continuous improvements in data infrastructure and processes.
  • Ensure data lineage documentation and metadata management.



Must have skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics, software engineering, or related roles.
  • 3+ years of experience managing consumer data from digital applications and websites.
  • 5+ years of Program Management experience
  • Strong proficiency in SQL.
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
  • Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB).
  • Knowledge of customer data platforms (CDPs) and data collection methods (SDKs, cookies, pixels, APIs).
  • Experience with event tracking frameworks and multi-partner integrations.
  • Understanding of web and mobile analytics tools (Amplitude, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Mixpanel).
  • Understanding of data privacy regulations.
  • Knowledge of A/B testing frameworks and experimentation platforms.
  • Experience with cloud data lake solutions (AWS S3, Glue, Athena, Azure Data Lake, Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery).
  • Proven experience leading technical teams and cross-functional projects.
  • Strong communication skills to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Front-end experience in mobile and web development (2+ years).
  • Organized with excellent communication skills.
  • Willingness to complete a background check.



Conditions

  • 100% Remote role, primary timezone UTC-4, with at least 6 hours overlap required.
  • Contractor role, 3-month contract, renewable.
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • Device provided by the client (no BYOD required).

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple clients, meetings, and deadlines simultaneously.

Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.

Escolaridade : Ensino Superior Completo. Pos-graduação Completa em Educação, Ciências Humanas, Sociais ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência Profissional : Sólida experiência em programas e projetos educacionais e/ou sociais relacionados à Aprendizagem Profissional (Lei nº 10.097/2000); na concepção, planejamento, execução, monitoramento de programas educacionais e sociais relacionados a Aprendizagem Profissional; na elaboração de documentos técnicos relacionados à Aprendizagem Profissional.

-Orientar e acompanhar a realização dos programas de aprendizagem profissional executados pelos Departamentos Regionais, visando assegurar aderência pedagógica, qualidade técnica e conformidade normativa.
-Propor melhorias para a execução dos programas de aprendizagem do Senac, em nível nacional para o aperfeiçoamento contínuo, com base em análises comparativas, evidências pedagógicas, indicadores de desempenho, demandas do mundo do trabalho, entre outros.

-Intermediar, junto aos Departamentos Regionais, o atendimento às demandas das empresas parceiras dos programas de aprendizagem, subsidiando solução de necessidades operacionais, pedagógicas e administrativo-regulatórias da aprendizagem.
-Analisar, diagnosticar e apresentar soluções técnico-administrativas relativas aos Programas de Aprendizagem Profissional do Senac, por meio de dados, indicadores, relatórios, conformidade, efetividade pedagógica, propondo recomendações técnico-administrativas para aprimoramento do programa em escala nacional.
-Elaborar documentos técnicos e analíticos relativos às demandas da Aprendizagem Profissional, abrangendo avaliações de impacto, comparativos entre regionais e recomendações estratégicas para subsidiar a tomada de decisão.
-Executar outras atividades, correlatas às descritas, desde que de mesma natureza e equivalentes graus de responsabilidade e complexidade.
Conhecimentos Técnicos:
Conceitos e fundamentos da educação profissional e tecnológica; normativas que regulamentam a Aprendizagem Profissional (Lei nº 10.097/2000; Decreto 9.579/2018; Portaria MTE 3.872/2023; dentre outras); informações técnico/operacionais da Aprendizagem Profissional; Catálogo Nacional da Aprendizagem (CONAP) e Cadastro Nacional da Aprendizagem Profissional (CNAP); redação de textos técnicos educacionais; Pacote Office em nível intermediário; ferramentas de apresentação (Canva, Power Point, Prezi entre outros).

title: Encarregado de logística
description:
Dover Fueling Solutions (" DFS"), uma empresa Dover (NYSE: DOV) composta pelos negócios Clear View, Fairbanks, Pro Gauge, Tokheim, Wayne Fueling Systems e OPW's Fuel Management Systems, oferece equipamentos avançados de abastecimento de combustíveis, sistemas eletrônicos e pagamento, medição automática de tanques e soluções de gerenciamento de estoque de líquidos para clientes em todo o mundo. Sediada em Austin, Texas, a DFS tem uma presença global significativa, incluindo instalações nos EUA, Reino Unido, Holanda, Suécia, França, Índia, China e Brasil. Para obter mais informações, visite .

Sumário: Coordenar as atividades do setor de logística, distribuir e orientar os serviços do Almoxarifado e Revenda, abrangendo o recebimento e armazenamento de peças nacionais e importadas, garantindo a acuracidade do estoque e os devidos registros de movimentações, acompanhar as atividades de expedição de peças e produtos acabados para o mercado interno e exportação, controlar todo o fluxo do processo de armazenagem dos armazéns internos e externos, coordenar as atividades de separação, embalagem e envio de peças e produtos de automação e intercompany, e processos de reparos eletrônicos com o objetivo de garantir a reposição de peças em campo e buscar soluções para eventuais problemas que possam ocorrer.
Responsabilidades definidas para o Encarregado do setor de almoxarifado:
Supervisionar a contagem cíclica e acompanhar as devidas análises bem como, tratativas das divergências quando necessário.
Gerir a equipe em todos os processos de desenvolvimento, treinamento de procedimentos/instruções de trabalho, assim como realizar manutenção de apontamento de ponto, programação de férias via sistema de Administração de Pessoal;
Prezar pelas condições de segurança de sua equipe no seu âmbito de atuação, atendendo aos requisitos legais da empresa, acompanhando uso e validade dos equipamentos, visando garantir o cumprimento de normas e exigências legais e da empresa;
Acompanhar as rotinas de recebimento e programar junto ao time de compras os recebimentos diários, a fim de adequar a capacidade de recebimento a demanda;
Garantir a gestão do fluxo de recebimento e armazenamento de materiais, garantindo acuracidade da conferência, movimentação física e sistêmica dos itens recebidos, e eliminar divergências de estoque e ajustes financeiros desnecessários;
Analisar junto ao time de Sourcing e Qualidade o melhor tipo de embalagem para os produtos recebidos a fim de garantir o melhor uso de espaço do armazém, facilitando assim a conferência, armazenagem e garantindo a conservação do produto durante o transporte e no armazém;
Informar diariamente a diretoria, área de vendas, suporte a cliente, planejamento de materiais, produção e setores envolvidos sobre o nível de estoque de produto acabado e solicitar / controlar Ordens de Pagamentos (POs) referentes aos pagamentos de fornecedores de fretes;
Participar de reuniões com a área de planejamento referente a programação de produção dos pedidos de revenda e monitorar estoque/itens em almoxarifado de peças fora de linha;
Garantir a continuidade do programa 5 S, ou similar, nas áreas sob sua responsabilidade;
Executar outras tarefas correlatas a critério do superior imediato.
Responsabilidades definidas para o Encarregado do setor de Revenda
Gerir a equipe em todos os processos de desenvolvimento, treinamento de procedimentos/instruções de trabalho, assim como realizar manutenção de apontamento de ponto, programação de férias via sistema de Administração de Pessoal;
Prezar pelas condições de segurança de sua equipe no seu âmbito de atuação, atendendo aos requisitos legais da empresa, acompanhando uso e validade dos equipamentos, visando garantir o cumprimento de normas e exigências legais e da empresa;
Identificar necessidades prioritárias de expedição de produtos acabados, coordenar a movimentação, armazenamento e organização dos materiais a serem expedidos, e coordenar todo o fluxo de saldos de produtos acabados internamente e em armazéns externos.
Realizar interface / acompanhamento, controles e negociações de prazos com empresas de transporte/correios, bem como elaborar indicador de desempenho de performance de transportadoras;
Informar diariamente a diretoria, área de vendas, suporte a cliente, planejamento de materiais, produção e setores envolvidos sobre o nível de estoque de produto acabado e solicitar / controlar Ordens de Pagamentos (POs) referentes aos pagamentos de fornecedores de fretes;
Acompanhar entrada de pedidos de revenda, automação e pedidos intercompany, garantindo o atendimento aos prazos estabelecidos, bem como controlar a base de dados e todas as informações pertinentes aos processos de expedição e logística reversa;
Garantir a continuidade do programa 5 S, ou similar, nas áreas sob sua responsabilidade;
Executar outras tarefas correlatas a critério do superior imediato.
Conhecimentos especificos / Habilidades:
Conhecimentos em ERP (preferência Oracle);
Conhecimentos em Excel (preferência Avançado);
Conhecimentos em Armazenagem e Frete;
Habilidade de comunicação / Liderança, Planejamento e relacionamento Interpessoal.
Qualificações básicas / formação: Ensino Médio completo ou Superior Completo em Administração, Engenharia Produção, logística ou afins.

title: Customer support / sales - south america and central america
description:
A posição de Customer Support / Sales será responsável por apoiar as atividades comerciais e o relacionamento com clientes na América do Sul e América Central. O profissional atuará como principal ponto de contato com os clientes da região, representando a voz do cliente dentro da organização e garantindo o adequado acompanhamento de suas demandas.
Entre as principais responsabilidades está a gestão do relacionamento com clientes, assegurando que solicitações, necessidades e expectativas sejam corretamente comunicadas e atendidas internamente.
O profissional também será responsável pela preparação e organização de cotações comerciais, que serão posteriormente enviadas ao time global de vendas, que conta com equipes atuando na Ásia, Índia e Estados Unidos.
Além disso, a posição dará suporte às atividades de vendas na América Latina, colaborando com o desenvolvimento comercial da região. Para questões técnicas, o profissional contará com o suporte da área técnica da empresa, porém será responsável pela coordenação e organização das cotações e do fluxo de informações comerciais.
A função também trabalhará em interface com a área de marketing, que atualmente conta com suporte da equipe liderada pela Ana e que está em processo de expansão.

Atuar como ponto de contato entre clientes e a empresa na América do Sul e Central
Representar a voz do cliente internamente
Acompanhar demandas e garantir o alinhamento com as necessidades dos clientes
Preparar e organizar cotações comerciais
Interagir com o time global de vendas
Apoiar o desenvolvimento de vendas na América Latina
Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas técnica e de marketing

title: Lead telecommunication engineer
description:
Our Client, a major oil and gas engineering company in Singapore, is seeking a highly experienced Lead Telecoms Engineer with 20+ years of expertise to manage their telecommunications package delivery. Agile HRO will handle the Singapore Employment Pass sponsorship and relocation for the successful Brazilian candidate.
Important: This position is located in Singapore and will require relocation.
Job Responsibilities:
Responsible as the Lead Engineer for all telecommunications-related engineering activities.
Manage and take full responsible for the delivery of the TSI/Telecoms Package.
Develop Telecoms Systems Specifications, TSI Scope of Work, and Bill of Materials.
Prepare Telecoms systems block diagram sketches.
Review telecoms systems studies such as PAGA coverage study, radio coverage study, VSAT link calculation, fiber optic link budget, etc.
Prepare requisitions and perform technical bid evaluations of Telecoms Systems.
Perform telecoms power consumption, heat dissipation, and weight estimation.
Liaise with clients to resolve engineering comments and provide solutions.
Coordinate with other disciplines and contractors on systems interfaces.
Lead, manage, guide, and mentor the Telecom Team throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring high-quality engineering deliverables.  
Job Requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (Telecommunications).
Minimum of 20 years of experience in Telecoms Detailed Engineering in the Oil and Gas industry, with at least 8 years of experience in Telecoms Package management.
Offshore project experience is preferred
Knowledge of international regulations, codes, and standards affecting Telecoms Systems.
Knowledge of Telecoms studies and calculations.
Proficient in writing Telecoms specifications.
Team player who can interact effectively with colleagues from other disciplines, clients, and suppliers

title: Chief engineer (process safety)
description:
Our Client, a leading oil and gas engineering firm in Singapore, is seeking a highly experienced Chief Engineer (Process Safety) with 22+ years of expertise to join their team. Agile HRO will handle the Singapore Employment Pass sponsorship and relocation for the successful Brazilian candidate.
Important: This role is based in Singapore and requires relocation
Role Description
Independently develop/oversee design safety philosophy, HSE Plan, and specifications for fire protection systems (active and passive), HFE, etc.
Lead/participate in process hazard reviews and analysis, including HAZOP/HAZID/SIL studies, and be responsible for action close-outs.
Lead/chair the HAZOP/HAZID/SIL workshops, if required.
Review third-party safety studies, including FERA, dispersion analysis, EERA, ESSA, dropped objects study, QRA studies, etc. (not limited to). Capable of independently carrying out similar safety studies, as required.
Independently design active and passive fire protection systems and prepare Hazardous/H2 S Area Classification documentation, safety and firefighting layouts, escape route and lifesaving equipment layout, and other safety drawings.
Carry out safety critical elements performance standards, RAM, fire and gas detection mapping, etc., based on project requirements.
Act as Package Engineer, if required, for safety and firefighting equipment.
Manage and guide Junior/Senior Engineers and Designers on Concept/FEED/Detailed Engineering projects.
Provide health and environmental inputs (including health risk assessments such as chemical exposure, noise and lighting, ergonomics/human factors engineering, environmental impact assessments, etc.) to projects.
Interface/coordinate with other engineering disciplines and clients, and take the lead in resolving technical matters related to safety aspects.
Deliver project safety deliverables as per the project schedule.
Provide inputs and support to projects in all safety aspects, including progress reports.
Provide advisory support and oversight to the Process Safety Team for their activities and deliverables and ensure technical integrity and quality.
Provide support for new bid proposals, including deliverable lists/manhour estimates, etc.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from an accredited university.
Minimum 22 years of relevant design engineering experience, including as a Technical Advisor.
Good HSE engineering experience in the oil and gas industry, in process safety/technical safety, with a minimum of 5-7 years in a lead position on similar projects.
Involvement in pre- Feed, Feed, Detail design projects for offshore (FPSO/platforms) and onshore (refineries, LNG facilities, storage terminals, etc.).
Experience in a minimum number of offshore projects (FPSO/platforms).
Good knowledge of oil and gas process facilities, local and international process safety codes and standards, and regulatory/marine codes and standards (MODU, SOLAS, DNV/Lloyds Register).
Hands-on experience in plot plan review, HAZID, HAZOP, SIL classification/verification, and other safety reviews (e.g., SIMOPS, ALARP).
Good working knowledge of PIPENET Vision, Flaresim, and other consequence modeling software such as DNV PHAST, etc.
Ability to influence designs to achieve optimal HSE outcomes.
A team player with leadership potential and proactive inter-discipline communication skills.

title: Billing analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2 B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.
Key Responsibilities
Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up. Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2 C) processes.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications
Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments. Our compensation package:
- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).
- Profit Sharing.
- Transportation vouchers.
- Meals vouchers.
- Health and Dental insurance.
- Birthday day off.

Realizar a gestão administrativa do contrato, validando a conformidade das entregas técnicas em relação aos marcos, critérios de qualidade e condições de pagamento previamente estabelecidas, subsidiando as tomadas de decisão.
Organizar, detalhar necessidades das áreas educacionais, traduzindo e refinando requisitos e critérios junto às áreas de negócio e TI, assegurando clareza, consistência e completude das informações fornecidas aos fornecedores para a adequada execução das atividades da área, a fim de subsidiar a atuação das equipes técnicas e fornecedores.
Facilitar a adoção de práticas ágeis entre as equipes, garantindo a compreensão e aplicação correta dos princípios e cerimônias.
Monitorar riscos do projeto, sinalizando desvios de prazo, custo ou escopo para a gestão imediata e propor planos de ação corretivos.
Garantir que a documentação funcional e técnica entregue pelo fornecedor atenda aos padrões exigidos pela governança da instituição.
Articular e facilitar a interface com áreas internas parceiras, antecipando demandas e viabilizando acessos, aprovações, validações e demais trâmites necessários para assegurar a execução contínua dos projetos.
Executar outras atividades correlatas às descritas, desde que de mesma natureza e equivalente grau de responsabilidade e complexidade.
Conhecimentos Técnicos:
Gestão de Projetos (PMBOK e Scrum). Ferramentas de gestão de tarefas (ex: Monday, Trello, Jira) e Pacote Office avançado.
Junte-se a nós e ajude a transformar vidas todos os dias!

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!
O desafio
Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership, tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.
O que você vai fazer:
Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi, com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance;
Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos, conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros, incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção. O que esperamos de você:
Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
Experiência prática com AWS, especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C);
Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação com segurança da informação, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
Experiência em ambientes de startup, lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos. Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início. Benefícios que oferecemos:

R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação
30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano

title: Solutions architect – data services
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks, data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh, data products, and Unity Catalog–based governance. This is a hands-on architect role, requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.
Key Responsibilities
Solution & Data Architecture
Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog, including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks. Data Platform Design & Governance
Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards. Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts
Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
Remain hands-on with:
Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment. Collaboration & Delivery Alignment
Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives. Technical Leadership & Mentorship
Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Architecture Documentation
Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs. Required Qualifications
7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks.
Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
Solid programming experience in Python and/or C#, including API and integration design.
Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, Dev Ops practices, and operational considerations.
Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead.
Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) and PI Planning.
Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, Plant UML, or Mermaid. Key Competencies
Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
Leadership and mentorship capabilities
Continuous learning and innovation mindset

title: Asb - auxiliar de saÚde bucal
description:
SORRISOS ODONTOLOGIA
Campo Grande, Rio de Janeiro • Presencial
⚠️ REQUISITOS ELIMINATÓ RIOS — LEIA ANTES DE SE CANDIDATAR ⚠️
Residência obrigatória a no máximo 8 km da clínica (Campo Grande, Bangu, Santa Cruz, Guaratiba ou Sepetiba)
Certificado de ASB com CRO ativo • Disponibilidade para início imediato
QUEM SOMOS
Na Sorrisos Odontologia, há mais de 14 anos nossa paixão é transformar vidas através de uma odontologia de excelência, ética, humana e responsável. Nossa missão é ser referência em saúde bucal, proporcionando uma experiência única e de alta qualidade para cada paciente.
Nossos valores guiam cada passo: acolhemos as pessoas com honestidade, comprometimento, dedicação e foco na qualidade. Se você busca um ambiente que preza por organização, processos eficientes, modernidade e um cuidado humanizado, você está no lugar certo!
A OPORTUNIDADE
Procuramos uma  Auxiliar de Saúde Bucal (ASB) que seja o braço direito dos nossos cirurgiões-dentistas e a alma da organização no nosso dia a dia. Você será fundamental para garantir o fluxo impecável dos atendimentos, a excelência nos processos de biossegurança e esterilização, e uma organização primorosa em cada detalhe.
PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES
Biossegurança e Esterilização
• Processo completo de lavagem, secagem, selagem e esterilização de instrumentais e canetas, seguindo rigorosamente o POP de Esterilização e as normas da ANVISA.
• Realização semanal de testes biológicos e químicos na autoclave, com registro e controle precisos.
• Manutenção quinzenal da autoclave (limpeza e reposição de água) e semanal do compressor.
Organização e Manutenção
• Preparo e organização dos consultórios, bancadas, gavetas e armários para cada atendimento, garantindo a prontidão 100% dos atendimentos.
• Limpeza e organização constante das salas de atendimento, esterilização e laboratório de prótese.
Gestão de Materiais e Estoque
• Controle rigoroso de entrada e saída de materiais, anotações e baixas precisas no estoque.
• Processo completo de compras quinzenal: anotação de necessidades, cotação com no mínimo 4 dentais, pedido, conferência (validade, quantidade, valor) e lançamento no sistema Odontoway.
• Compras de materiais estratégicos como implantes, osso e membrana.
Suporte Clínico e Assistência
• Auxílio direto aos cirurgiões-dentistas em todos os procedimentos (clínicos e cirúrgicos), com agilidade e proatividade.
• Limpezas pós-cirúrgicas específicas (borracha de soro, rede de sugador) e confecção de placas de clareamento.
• Preenchimento de comunicação interna e criação de requisições no sistema.
Gestão de Laboratório e Prótese
• Organizar trabalhos para envio, criar requisições e entrar em contato com o laboratório para coletas.
• Verificar o retorno dos trabalhos, lançar no sistema (valor, data, conformidade) e atualizar o status no sistema de gestão.
• Cobrar trabalhos com mais de 7 dias em aberto junto ao laboratório.
O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS
• Organização e Meticulosidade: Perfil sistemático, detalhista e orientado a processos. Para você, cada item tem seu lugar e cada tarefa é executada com precisão.
• Proatividade e Autonomia: Você não espera ser acionada — antecipa as necessidades, age com iniciativa e resolve situações sem supervisão constante.
• Comprometimento e Responsabilidade: Senso de dever inabalável, dedicação genuína e paixão pela entrega de um serviço de alta qualidade.
• Racionalidade e Resolução de Problemas: Abordagem lógica e prática para desafios do dia a dia, buscando otimizar tempo e recursos.
• Habilidade com Ferramentas Digitais: Facilidade em aprender e operar softwares específicos (Clinicorp) e planilhas.
• Empatia e Colaboração: Contribui para um ambiente acolhedor e harmonioso, tanto para pacientes quanto para a equipe.
• Recepção de Feedback: Abertura e maturidade profissional para receber, valorizar e implementar feedbacks de forma positiva e construtiva.
POR QUE SE JUNTAR À SORRISOS?
• Propósito Transformador: Impacte vidas entregando saúde bucal, sorrisos e autoestima.
• Remuneração Competitiva: Salário fixo de R$ 1.800,00 + Adicional de Insalubridade.
• Regime CLT: Contratação formal com todos os benefícios garantidos.
• Horário: Segunda a sexta, 09:30h às 19h e sábados quinzenais de 08:00h às 14:00h.
• Ambiente de Excelência: Clínica moderna, organizada e que investe em tecnologia (inclusive IA para otimização de processos).
• Cultura de Valorização: Seu comprometimento, proatividade e atenção aos detalhes são reconhecidos e valorizados.
• Desenvolvimento Contínuo: Ambiente dinâmico de alta performance com oportunidades reais de crescimento.
COMO SE CANDIDATAR
Envie seu currículo para  com o assunto:
“VAGA ASB — (SEU BAIRRO)”
Exemplo: “VAGA ASB — CAMPO GRANDE” ⚠️ IMPORTANTE:  Currículos sem informação do bairro ou de candidatas que não residam nas áreas informadas não serão avaliados.
Se você busca uma oportunidade onde sua proatividade, organização e comprometimento farão a diferença na transformação de sorrisos e vidas, queremos conhecer você! #ASB #Auxiliar De Saúde Bucal #Odontologia #Vaga De Emprego #Campo Grande RJ #Sorrisos Odontologia #Vagas RJ

title: Data engineer - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!
What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.
Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
Collaboratewith data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
OptimizeETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
Maintainand improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
Troubleshootand resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.
What we are looking for:
A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
Curiosity:You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
Collaboration:Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship:You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
Fluent English:You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.
What We Offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
