title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
- Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
- Advanced English (spoken and written),
- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
- Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
- Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
- Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
- Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
- Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
- Hybrid working model,
- One day off on your birthday,
- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
- Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
- Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
- Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
- Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Representante comercial b2b
description:

O profissional será responsável por identificar e prospectar novos clientes no segmento B2 B, apresentar nossos produtos, negociar contratos e manter relacionamentos de longo prazo com parceiros comerciais. O trabalho será realizado em um modelo híbrido, com base em Rio de Janeiro, RJ e possibilidade de home office em dias específicos.
Qualificações
Venda e Negociação: Experiência em vendas no modelo B2 B. Habilidade em realizar negociações comerciais e fechamento de contratos.
Relacionamento com o cliente: Capacidade de construir e manter relacionamentos produtivos de longo prazo com diferentes stakeholders.
Habilidades de Comunicação: Comunicação clara e objetiva, com habilidade para apresentações comerciais e interações com clientes e equipe.
Conhecimento em gestão de carteira de clientes, análise de mercado e identificação de oportunidades será um diferencial. Sobre a oportunidade
A Onivino busca profissionais com perfil comercial e consultivo para atuar no desenvolvimento de negócios n o
mercado B2 B d e vinhos.
O representante atuará no relacionamento com clientes dos canais On-Trade (restaurantes, bares e hotéis) e
Off-Trade (empórios, supermercados e lojas especializadas), contribuindo para a expansão da presença do portfólio
da empresa e desenvolvimento das marcas n o mercado.
A atuação ocorre de forma autônoma, e m alinhamento com as estratégias comerciais d a empresa, com foco no
desenvolvimento d e oportunidades comerciais e expansão da carteira de clientes.
Principais Responsabilidades
Desenvolvimento Comercial e Prospecção
• Identificar e desenvolver oportunidades comerciais nos canais On-Trade e Off-Trade dentro da região de atuação.
• Prospectar novos clientes por meio d e visitas comerciais, networking, indicações e mapeamento de mercado.
• Apresentar o portfólio d a empresa, identificando oportunidades de inclusão de rótulos e desenvolvimento d e mix
nos clientes.
• Contribuir para a abertura de novos pontos d e venda alinhados ao posicionamento das marcas.
Desenvolvimento e Gestão d a Carteira de Clientes
• Desenvolver relacionamento comercial com clientes d a carteira buscando oportunidades recorrentes d e negócio.
• Acompanhar o desempenho dos clientes atendidos e identificar oportunidades de crescimento do portfólio.
• Atuar como parceiro comercial dos clientes, contribuindo com sugestões de posicionamento de produtos e
oportunidades d e venda.
• Estimular recompra e continuidade das relações comerciais.
Execução da Estratégia Comercial
• Atuar e m alinhamento com as estratégias comerciais definidas pela empresa para os canais atendidos.
• Apresentar o portfólio considerando perfil d e consumo do cliente e potencial d e desenvolvimento das marcas.
• Contribuir para o aumento d o mix de produtos e ampliação da presença d o portfólio nos pontos d e venda.
• Apoiar iniciativas comerciais e ativações de marca quando aplicável.
Acompanhamento d e Oportunidades Comerciais
• Manter registro organizado das atividades comerciais utilizando materiais internos de acompanhamento, como
planilhas comerciais, relatórios e apresentações padronizadas.
• Atualizar informações relacionadas a: leads prospectados; oportunidades comerciais e m desenvolvimento;
negociações em andamento; clientes ativos da carteira.
• Compartilhar informações relevantes sobre evolução das oportunidades e negociações.
ONIVINO
Planejamento da Atuação Comercial
• Organizar a atuação comercial na região de atendimento, buscando eficiência n o relacionamento com clientes e
prospecção d e novos negócios.
• Planejar visitas e contatos comerciais de acordo com oportunidades identificadas e potencial de mercado.
• Priorizar clientes estratégicos e oportunidades com maior potencial d e desenvolvimento comercial.
Acompanhamento d e Pedidos e Operações Comerciais

processamento dos pedidos.
• Acompanhar o andamento das vendas realizadas, contribuindo para uma boa experiência d o cliente no
relacionamento comercial com a empresa.
• Apoiar a resolução d e eventuais questões operacionais relacionadas aos pedidos quando necessário.

• Compartilhar percepções e informações de mercado que contribuam para o desenvolvimento das estratégias
comerciais da empresa.

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
• Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
• Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
• Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
• Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
• Advanced English (spoken and written),
• Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
• Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
• Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
• High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
• Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
• Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
• Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
• Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
• Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
• Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
• Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
• Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
• Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
• Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
• Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
• Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
• Hybrid working model,
• One day off on your birthday,
• Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
• Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
• Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
• Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
• Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
• Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
• Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
• Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our \"One World\" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

description:
About Voxy
Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss.
You can find additional information about our values at this link (
The Impact You'll Have at Voxy
Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.
What You'll Be Doing:
Collections & Cash Application:
• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.
• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.
• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.
• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager.
• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.
• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.
• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.
Credit Analysis & Risk Management:
• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.
• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.
Reporting & Analysis:
• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst.
What We're Looking For:
• B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
• Based anywhere in Brazil
• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish
• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.
Job Details:
• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year
• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)
In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy:
• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)
• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events
• Remote friendly work policies
• Professional development budget
• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify
• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world
• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)
We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.
Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.
As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.

title: Técnico de serviços em maritimo
description:
Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito.
A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Rio para Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.
Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo:
Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado.
Tipos de equipamentos atendidos:
• Radares
• ECDIS
• Satcoms
• Rádios HF e VHF
• GPS
• Girobússola
• Pilotos automáticos
• Sirenes
Qualificações do Técnico em Marítima:
• Mais de 3 anos como MST na indústria de transporte marítimo comercial.
• Um diploma universitário em engenharia ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.
• Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.
• Forte conhecimento de teoria e aplicação de eletrônica.

title: Technical Expert
description:

  • Flexibility: For us, hybrid and flexible working is all about trust, and we want you to be able to do your best work (depending on the role).

title: Arquiteto De Software
description:
A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting.


Propósito do Cargo

Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix . Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia.


Responsabilidades Principais:


Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma

  • Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório.
  • Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento.
  • Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura.
  • Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade.
  • Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos.


Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL

  • Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro.
  • Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos.
  • Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho.


Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código

  • Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas.
  • Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma.
  • Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura.
  • Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos.


Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área.
  • Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades.
  • Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa.


Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA

  • Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes.
  • Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa.
  • Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais.
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes).
  • Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos).
  • Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE).
  • Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging.
  • Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem.
  • Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado.
  • Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes).
  • Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras.
  • Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros).
  • Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting.
  • Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC).
  • Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços.
  • Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação.


Processo de Candidatura:

  1. Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo .
  2. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo.
  3. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência.
  4. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix

Na VMetrix , não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.

Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
    plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
    proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.


Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

- Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

- Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

- Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

- Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

- Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

- Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

- Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

- Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

- Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

- Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.

- Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.


Be fully aligned to our core values:

- Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

- Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

- Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

- Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.

- Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

- Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.

- Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.

- Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.

- An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

Lilo Social is seeking a Creative Strategist to lead performance-driven creative strategy across a portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will own the end-to-end creative testing engine—from research and messaging frameworks to briefs, storyboards, conversion rate optimization ideas, and ongoing iteration—helping clients consistently find creative winners and scale spend profitably. This is a highly cross-functional role where you will partner closely with design, video, media buying, and account teams while working directly with clients to set creative direction, align on priorities, and build repeatable roadmaps for growth.


What Success Looks Like

  • A clear, repeatable creative testing system running across your client portfolio with consistent velocity to new concepts, angles, and iterations
  • Creative insights that translate into measurable performance improvements including higher click-through rates, conversion rates, lower customer acquisition costs, and scalable winning campaigns
  • Strong client trust in your strategic point of view, demonstrated through proactive communication, data-backed recommendations, and leadership in creative direction
  • Elevated internal creative standards through contributions to team training, standard operating procedures, and systems that improve output quality and speed


Responsibilities

  • Lead research and insights by mining customer reviews, competitor ads libraries, audience pain points, and product differentiators to identify winning angles and positioning strategies
  • Own creative testing strategy by building and managing structured testing roadmaps with clear hypotheses, variables to test, iteration plans, and learning agendas
  • Create world-class creative briefs that transform insights into crisp, actionable direction for designers and video editors including hooks, messaging frameworks, visual concepts, format specifications, and success criteria
  • Direct performance storytelling by mapping the customer journey from awareness through consideration to purchase and translating it into compelling paid social concepts
  • Build UGC and production guidance including shot lists, video scripts, creator direction, and content planning that supports performance-oriented execution
  • Manage creator relationships by sourcing, coordinating, and guiding content creators to produce on-brief, performance-oriented content that aligns with testing objectives
  • Write high-performing ad copy including primary text, headlines, hooks, and on-screen text that aligns with strategic goals and testing frameworks
  • Collaborate on conversion rate optimization by partnering with teams on landing page improvements and conversion-focused messaging updates
  • Track and communicate performance by monitoring key performance indicators by concept and angle, synthesizing learnings, and reporting insights to internal teams and clients
  • Develop inspiration and competitor boards to inform creative direction and identify market trends and opportunities
  • Lead copy across paid ads for in-ad copy and headline variations that drive engagement and conversions


Requirements

  • 1-2 years of experience in ecommerce or performance marketing with strong preference for direct-to-consumer brand experience
  • Proven track record of paid social creative strategy with expertise in Meta Ads (required) and familiarity with TikTok or YouTube (preferred)
  • Strong grasp of creative testing methodology including hypothesis development, structured testing frameworks, iteration velocity, and performance analysis
  • Experience working with design and video teams from brief development through execution to iteration, with ability to provide clear, actionable creative direction
  • Data-fluent approach with comfort using performance metrics including click-through rates, conversion rates, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend to make decisions and guide priorities
  • Deep understanding of customer psychology, marketing funnels, and storytelling principles that drive direct response performance
  • Excellent copywriting skills across multiple formats including hooks, scripts, ad copy, and landing pages with proven ability to write persuasive, conversion-focused content
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, quality control processes, and ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously
  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, Shopify, Google Analytics, Figma, Motion, and collaboration tools including Slack, Asana, or Notion


Nice to Have

  • Client-facing experience including presenting strategy, leading client calls, and confidently pushing for action based on data and creative insights
  • Experience with conversion rate optimization and landing page testing frameworks to improve post-click performance
  • Experience building creative playbooks, training materials, or onboarding systems for creative teams
  • Familiarity with additional paid social platforms including TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads, or Pinterest Ads
  • Background in agency environments managing multiple client accounts with varying needs and timelines


Compensation and Benefits

  • Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere working US hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Account Manager
description:
Remote | Full-time | Core hours: 8:00 AM–4:00 PM EST


Macedo Marketing is a performance-driven paid ads agency working with eCommerce and digital product brands in tier-one markets.


We’re hiring an Account Manager who can own client communication end-to-end, keep things calm when results fluctuate, and drive retention through clarity, trust, and solid execution.


About Macedo Marketing

  • We help eCommerce and digital product brands grow through paid advertising and creative strategy.
  • We’re direct, high standards, and process-driven. We care about results, but we also care about how we get them: honest communication, clear ownership, and no drama.
  • You’ll work closely with media buyers and creatives, but you’ll own the client relationship.


The Role

  • As an Account Manager, your job is to keep 15–20 clients aligned, confident, and moving forward. This is not a “smile and reassure” role. It’s a client-trust role.
  • You’ll lead client calls, handle day-to-day communication, translate performance into clear updates, and make sure the internal team is aligned on what matters most for each account.


Mission

Ensure clients feel confident, informed, and supported while achieving strong performance outcomes, leading to long-term retention and account growth.


Success looks like

  • Clients stay longer because they trust you
  • Issues get handled early, not after clients complain
  • Performance dips don’t turn into chaos
  • Clients understand what’s happening and what’s next
  • Upsell opportunities are spotted and surfaced responsibly


What You’ll Do

  • Own client communication and calls for your book of accounts (15–20 clients)
  • Run weekly or bi-weekly calls with clear structure, next steps, and accountability
  • Translate performance updates into clear, honest client communication


When performance dips:

  • Calmly explain the situation to the client with facts and context
  • Push internally for clarity and corrective action with the media buyer/creative team
  • Keep timelines, deliverables, and follow-ups clean and tracked
  • Make sure client questions don’t sit unanswered
  • Spot upsell and expansion opportunities and flag them internally
  • Collect testimonials / positive feedback at the right moments


This Will Be For You If…

  • You have 3+ years in account management / client success (agency experience is a strong plus)
  • You’re native or fully fluent in English and comfortable leading client calls
  • You’re calm under pressure and don’t take client stress personally
  • You’re organized, detail-oriented, and move fast on important tasks
  • You don’t overpromise to “make the client happy” — you align internally first
  • You’re curious about paid ads and want to deepen your understanding of Meta/Google fundamentals
  • You can handle a client load of 15–20 without dropping quality


Do Not Apply If…

  • You tend to procrastinate or take too long to handle time-sensitive issues
  • You leave client questions unanswered or avoid uncomfortable conversations
  • You “smooth things over” by making commitments without internal approval
  • You’re not interested in learning the basics of paid ads and how our delivery process works
  • You need constant supervision to stay organized


Why Join Macedo Marketing

  • Clear expectations and ownership: you’ll know what “good” tells like here
  • Direct access to leadership: fast decisions, no corporate layers
  • High standards, low drama: we care about performance and professionalism
  • 100% remote: work from anywhere, as long as you overlap 8 AM–4 PM EST
  • Growth path: this role can develop into a Senior AM / Client Lead position
  • Compensation is competitive and based on experience. We’ll ask for expectations in the application.


How to Apply

  • Apply via
  • We’ll send a short application form to shortlisted candidates
  • First interview for standout applications
  • We move quickly with the right people.

title: Institutional Relations Manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.


Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships™ and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership™ fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership™, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.


We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.


WHAT DO WE EXPECT?


- Bachelor’s degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields;
postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,

- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),

- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,

- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),

- Advanced English (spoken and written),

- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,

- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,

- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,

- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,

- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,

- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.


WHAT AWAITS YOU?


- Lead and execute KPS Brazil’s institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,

- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,

- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,

- Proactively represent and defend the company’s interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,

- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),

- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,

- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,

- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company’s institutional positioning,

- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,

- Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,

- Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS’s institutional presence in Brazil,

- Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.


WHAT DO WE OFFER?


- Hybrid working model,

- One day off on your birthday,

- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,

- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,

- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,

- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),

- Well-being and quality of life programs, including TotalPass,

- Professional and personal training and development opportunities,

- Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,

- Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.


In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.


In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Operador De Usv
description:
Sobre a TideWise

A TideWise é uma empresa brasileira pioneira no desenvolvimento, integração e operação de sistemas robóticos inteligentes voltados para as demandas da indústria marítima. Nossa missão é acelerar a transição para um setor mais seguro e sustentável, utilizando tecnologia de ponta para aumentar a segurança, confiabilidade e eficiência, ao mesmo tempo em que reduzimos o impacto ambiental e os custos operacionais.


Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de Operadores de USV para integrar nossa equipe de operações. Esta é uma posição que une a experiência marítima tradicional com a fronteira da robótica. Você será responsável pela condução de embarcações não tripuladas em missões portuárias, costeiras e offshore, garantindo a continuidade operacional através de sistemas de controle remoto e autônomo.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


1. Operação do USV (Missão / ROC / Campo)

  • Operar o USV via Centro de Operações Remotas (ROC), assegurando a segurança da navegação, prontidão e cumprimento de limites operacionais.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de Survey (sonares e ROVs) para a perfeita execução da missão.
  • Executar watchkeeping remoto, mantendo consciência situacional total (tráfego, áreas restritas, aproximações e atracações) com aplicação prática de RIPEAM.
  • Realizar handover estruturado entre turnos (briefing/debriefing), garantindo rastreabilidade de status, pendências, registro de alarmes e decisões.


2. Planejamento, Checklists e Disciplina de Execução

  • Preparar e conduzir Planos de Navegação, Planos Operacionais e Checklists por missão e por embarcação.
  • Elaborar análise de riscos detalhada para as missões.
  • Diagnóstico Técnico: Diferente de um oficial convencional, você deve identificar falhas em sistemas críticos (propulsão, geradores, link de comunicação) interpretando logs e alarmes, coordenando ações com a equipe de manutenção.
  • Realizar validações críticas (energia, arrefecimento, propulsão, comandos, sensores essenciais e comunicações) antes de assumir missões.
  • Preencher e emitir DPR (Daily Progress Report) para todas as operações.


3. Manobras e Modos de Operação

  • Conduzir transições entre modos de trânsito e Posicionamento Dinâmico (DP), decidindo a troca de modo por condições ambientais ou objetivo de missão.
  • Apoiar rotinas de convés: amarração, mobilização/desmobilização, reboque e verificações de prontidão de navegação.


4. Segurança, Contingência e Cibernética

  • Executar avaliação dinâmica de risco e garantir conformidade com o sistema de gestão (reporte de incidentes e "quase acidentes").
  • Operar sob procedimentos de contingência: quebra de ciclo, perda de sinal/controle, retorno seguro e falha segura.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança cibernética operacional (segregação de redes, controle de acesso e disciplina de uso de equipamentos).


5. Registros e Evidências

  • Produzir relatórios diários: linha do tempo, consumo, performance, alarmes e parâmetros exigidos por clientes.
  • Consolidar evidências para auditorias e lições aprendidas (limitações identificadas e recomendações de evolução).


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Aquaviário do 1º Grupo (Marítimo) – Seção de Convés: Oficial de Náutica (ON) ou CTR (Nível 5+).
  • Certificações: STCW válidos e compatíveis (II/3, II/5 e IV/2 - Rádio-Operador).
  • Experiência Prática: Navegação de embarcações de pequeno porte (menor que 20m e propulsão com dois eixos).
  • Navegação em regiões de alta densidade de tráfego não controlado (pesca e recreio).
  • Vivência em ambiente offshore/portuário e rotinas de convés.
  • Tecnologia: Experiência prévia com operações remotas (COR/ROC), VTS/VTMIS ou sistemas não tripulados (USV/ROV/UAV).
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Experiência com mobilização, integração de sensores, testes e comissionamento básico.
  • Idiomas: Inglês instrumental (leitura de manuais, troubleshooting e comunicação técnica).


Perfil Comportamental (Soft Skills)

  • Disciplina operacional e rigor com normas/procedimentos.
  • Consciência situacional sob carga cognitiva e tomada de decisão sob pressão.
  • Comunicação clara, padronizada e fraseologia operacional (VHF).
  • Trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar, ética e integridade.


Benefícios TideWise:

  • Vale Refeição, Vale Alimentação e Mobilidade oferecidos no Cartão Caju Benefícios.
  • Adicional de 25% no Vale-Alimentação por filho com idade inferior a 21 anos.
  • Plano de Saúde e Plano Dental Sulamérica sem coparticipação para colaboradores.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • WellHub.


Junte-se à Tidewise e participe da revolução tecnológica no setor marítimo!

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - (Vue / Node.Js)
description:
This is a 100% Remote Independent Contractor Role.


About Equate Media

Equate Media is a growth-focused digital company that builds software and operational systems designed to improve efficiency, support customer engagement, and drive measurable business results. Our teams work closely across engineering, marketing, and operations to solve practical problems, improve workflows, and create systems that make a real impact. We value speed, ownership, adaptability, and people who enjoy building useful things in a fast-moving environment.


About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer to help strengthen and expand a real-time communications platform used every day by the business. This person will step into an existing production environment, work through active issues, improve platform reliability, and help push new functionality into production quickly.


The work touches both frontend and backend systems tied to inbound and outbound call activity, routing logic, internal buffering, operational tooling, and live user workflows. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving real production problems, working across the stack, and making meaningful contributions without a lot of hand-holding.


Where you’ll make an impact

  • Get up to speed quickly in an existing multi-service production platform
  • Investigate and resolve issues across frontend, backend, and third-party integrations
  • Deliver new features at a high pace while keeping stability and maintainability in mind
  • Improve systems that support real-time call flows, routing behavior, and internal buffering
  • Build and refine interfaces used for live operations and communication workflows
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and platform functionality tied directly to business performance
  • Help improve visibility, reliability, and overall behavior in a live production environment
  • Contribute to engineering decisions and help raise execution standards across the team


Tools and environment

  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Pinia, Vue Router
  • Backend: Node.Js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Express
  • Real-time / Communications: Socket.IO, WebRTC, browser based calling with Twilio/Sinch/similar system
  • Infrastructure / Services: AWS, Redis, RabbitMQ / AMQP, PM2
  • Monitoring / Error Tracking: Sentry


What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience as a full stack software developer
  • Strong backend experience with Node.Js
  • Strong frontend experience with Vue, or strong experience with a modern frontend framework and the ability to work confidently in a Vue codebase
  • Experience working in existing production systems, not only creating from scratch
  • Ability to troubleshoot across the stack and solve real-world issues efficiently
  • Experience shipping features quickly in fast-moving environments
  • Strong instincts around performance, reliability, and maintainability
  • Comfortable taking ownership and operating independently
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud-based production environments
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams


Bonus Points For

  • Telephony, VoIP, call routing, or communications platforms
  • Twilio, Sinch, or similar providers
  • Real-time systems, event-driven architecture, queues, or worker-based services
  • Redis, RabbitMQ, or live operational workflows
  • Improving legacy systems while continuing to ship new functionality
  • Exposure to AI-assisted workflows such as transcription, summarization, or automation


Why this role stands out

This is an opportunity to work on a live platform that supports real operational activity and directly impacts the business. You’ll be solving practical problems, improving systems that people rely on every day, and helping shape what gets built next. If you enjoy working in production systems, fixing meaningful problems, and shipping useful features quickly, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Sustainability Specialist
description:
Junior Sustainability Specialist

Location : Remote (Brazil)

Contract : 6 months - 40 hours/wk

Rate : $4-6/hr USD - BRL $4,330-5,200 / month


Job Description

Insight Global is looking for an entry‑level Sustainability Analyst / Sustainability Specialist to join our client's growing sustainability function. This role will support a small, highly collaborative sustainability team of two and will play a hands‑on role in sustainability reporting, environmental impact analysis, and data‑driven research initiatives.


This is an excellent opportunity for a new graduate with relevant academic or project experience, or an early‑career professional (1–3 years of experience) looking to grow their career in corporate sustainability within a global SaaS organization. The role is fully remote within Brazil and requires strong English communication skills due to close collaboration with international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support sustainability reporting initiatives, including data collection, validation, and preparation of internal and external sustainability disclosures.
  • Perform Excel‑based data analysis related to environmental and sustainability metrics, including working with large datasets to identify trends and insights.
  • Assist with environmental impact reporting, including drafting written content and supporting documentation for sustainability reports and customer‑facing materials.
  • Conduct customer and market research related to sustainability programs, expectations, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with the sustainability team and cross‑functional partners to support ongoing sustainability initiatives and operational priorities.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Environmental Studies, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience supporting sustainability or ESG reporting through academic projects, internships, or professional roles.
  • Strong Excel skills, including data analysis using pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and basic data validation techniques.
  • Experience conducting structured research and synthesizing findings into clear written outputs.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a global, remote environment.


Nice to Have

  • Exposure to carbon accounting, greenhouse gas (GHG) inventories, or climate‑related data analysis.
  • Familiarity with sustainability or ESG frameworks (e.G., GRI, SASB, TCFD, CDP) through coursework or practical experience.
  • Experience working in a SaaS, technology, or professional services environment.
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where priorities may evolve quickly.

title: Duteiro
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, naplanta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, naunidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera. Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade. Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Principais atividades: Acompanhar e executar atividades de manutenção mecânica em paradas programadas/corretivas e orientar e acompanhar os serviços de manutenção das empresas prestadoras de serviços;
Anotar os reparos feitos em ordens de serviços e peças trocadas, para manutenção e emitir ordens de serviço para execução das mesmas;
Inspecionar novos materiais mecânicos para serem adicionados em estoque;
Participar do planejamento de programação de manutenção corretiva planejada, preventiva e preditiva, visando minimizar o tempo não produtivo dos equipamentos;
Preencher/executar asordens de manutenção planejadas no SAP-PM corretamente, registrando informações pertinentes, como: dados de intervenção, especialidades envolvidas, HH, tempos e custos de manutenção, soluções aplicadas, recomendações futuras e observações importantes;
Acompanhar as manutenções emergenciais, programando sua imediata execução;
Realizar análise de falhas conforme os critérios padrões e se comprometer com os planos de ações bem como o bloqueio das falhas. Requisitos: Ensino Técnico Completo em Mecânica ou Eletromecânica;
Experiência com manutenção em ambiente industrial;
Desejável ensino superior cursando;
Desejável experiênciana área de Madeiras ou Papel/Celulose;
Residir na região de Montenegro/RS.

title: Software Engineer - Go - Container Images
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Canonical is building a new generation of Ubuntu‑based container images to simplify open‑source application deployment across the world. These container images will be free to use with long‑term security commitments, and engineered for performance, security and usability. As with Ubuntu, we will work in the open and welcome community participation.

In this role, you’ll be developing the tools and technology for building and maintaining this new generation of container images. You’ll be working with multiple teams, both inside and outside Canonical, to ensure we deliver container images with the highest quality whilst maintaining a seamless Ubuntu user experience. You will also be highly involved in the implementation and maintenance of the Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery automation around these container images, for which you are expected to demonstrate deep insights into container‑based DevOps.

You will be contributing to fast‑moving products like Rocks (OCI images) and Chisel, and thus have the chance to help steer and consolidate this new team. You’ll gain experience with numerous container technologies and participate in exciting and exploratory tasks, where your feedback will be critical for the decision‑making process. As an engineer, your seniority will be based on your software development background and ability to lead junior team members.

Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical. This is an exciting opportunity for experienced software engineers looking for a place to leave their mark, who are passionate about shaping an open source product with the highest quality, with and for the community!

Location

EMEA

Responsibilities

  • Build robust, scalable, leading‑edge container images
  • Work on automated Ci/CD processes for building, testing and publishing our container images
  • Write tools and tests for assessing security compliance and cloud‑native compatibility
  • Work in Go to deliver new functionalities to our container‑building tools
  • Participate in strong engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Provide technical feedback for the team’s decision‑making process
  • Engage with the open‑source community as a subject‑matter expert
  • Grow our knowledge base and write documentation
  • Work in a collaborative, agile and globally distributed environment
  • Mentor and help hiring
  • Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events

Qualifications

  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are a team player and have experience in collaborative development
  • You have worked with CI/CD systems (e.g. Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Concourse CI, etc.)
  • You have a track record of delivering timely, high‑quality software
  • You have experience with container images and containerised operations
  • You master at least one container management/orchestration tool (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • You have significant experience with Go
  • You are experienced with Linux systems administration and package management
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills to convey technical concepts
  • You bring clarity to technical and engineering discussions
  • You are someone who strongly believes that sharing is caring, and knowledge is power
  • Your skills range from those of a Graduate to a mid‑senior Software Engineer
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree

Benefits

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence — in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A Ortobom iniciou suas atividades em 1969, fabricando camas e mesas de metal. Atenta às novas tendências, a empresa passou a comprar blocos de espuma para a confecção de colchões, que harmoniosamente se casavam com as camas.

Em 1975, a Ortobom inaugurou no Rio de Janeiro a primeira fábrica especializada na fabricação de colchões. O objetivo era a produção e comercialização de colchões que proporcionassem o máximo de bem-estar e conforto aos clientes.

O sonho virou realidade. Hoje a Ortobom possui 12 fábricas e 400.000 m2 de área construída. São mais de 2.000 lojas no Brasil, com filiais também na Bolívia, Uruguai e Paraguai. O setor fabril, se somado, tem uma área superior a de grandes montadoras de automóveis.

A Ortobom é a maior produtora de colchões da América Latina e a 2ª maior produtora de espuma do mundo.

A qualidade é garantida através de um investimento constante em tecnologia, desde a matéria-prima ao maquinário. Toda essa estrutura só é possível graças ao potencial humano: são mais de 6.000 colaboradores, 1.000 franqueados e 5.000 consultores em todo o Brasil.
